title: A receipt repeated within its window is neither re-announced nor re-drawn
body:
## Summary
showToast with the same message while the toast is open leaves the live region's text unchanged, so a screen reader stays silent and the screen shows no change.

## Description
app/(studio)/_shell/toast.ts:24-31 replaces the receipt and restarts the clock; packages/ui/src/components/toast/Toast.tsx:21-22 writes `open ? message : ""` into one always-mounted role=status. An identical string is not a DOM mutation, so the second 'duplicated · x' or 'kept 12' within 3.4 s is not voiced (registry accessibility/live-region-architecture, 'An unchanged string is not a mutation'). Fixed: the queue stamps each receipt with a sequence and Toast keys its text node by it, so a repeat is a remount.

## Flow
- press an act twice within 3.4 s whose receipt text is the same
- toast.ts set() -> Toast renders the same text -> no mutation -> no announcement
- fix: Receipt gains `seq`; Toast keys a <span key={seq}> around the message

## Expected impact
Screen-reader users hear every receipt; sighted users see no change either way. Could break: a caller that relies on an identical repeat being silent (none found).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every receipt is announced, repeats included
Before: 2 identical receipts in one window -> 1 region mutation (walked: toast.ts set() and Toast markup)
After: predicted 2 mutations
Method: simulation - Toast is a prop change in this context but the sequence lives in app/(studio)/_shell/toast.ts (studio-shell); no DOM in vitest to count mutations, the instrument is a keyed-render assertion
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: tests/next-server/shell-toast.test.ts: showToast(x) twice -> two distinct receipt seq; controls.test.ts: Toast with seq 1 vs 2 renders different keyed span (renderToStaticMarkup + element key). Before 1 distinct, after 2.

title: Every Button with an href is a full document load
body:
## Summary
Button renders an in-app href as a plain <a>, so each press reloads the document and remounts the shell.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/button/Button.tsx:52-58 returns <a href>; @gt/ui imports nothing from next/* (0 files), by design. 19 Button href call sites (16 in app/, e.g. ledger/_ledger/Detail.tsx:130 'Open record', library/_library/DetailView.tsx:186-187, projects/import/ImportView.tsx:228,238). Each press re-runs Providers (session POST, SSE reopen, toast dropped) - the same cost studio-shell's HeaderBar card measured for the header. Fixed: a link seam (`LinkProvider` in @gt/ui, supplied by the shell with next/link) that Button, Chip and Crumbs read.

## Flow
- Ledger detail -> press 'Open record' -> document navigation -> shell remount
- fix: @gt/ui exports a link context with a plain-<a> default; app/(studio)/_shell provides next/link; Button/Chip/Crumbs use it

## Expected impact
Section-internal doors stop paying a reload. Could break: a page that relied on the reload to reset module state.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - document loads per in-app Button press
Before: 1 document load per press, 19 call sites (code read)
After: predicted 0 per press
Method: simulation - needs a browser to count navigation entries; dev servers are out of this round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: tests/live: press 'Open record' on /ledger and assert performance.getEntriesByType('navigation').length stays 1 and the SSE EventSource is not reopened; before 2 navigations, after 1
drain_note: L: needs a link context across Chip, Crumbs, Providers

title: Field cannot say disabled, type or length, so 51 controls hand-roll it
body:
## Summary
51 raw <input>/<select>/<textarea> text controls sit beside 22 Field/Select/Search adopters; Field has no disabled, type, maxLength or multiline, so callers copy its class instead.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/field/Field.tsx:11-18 takes label/value/onChange/placeholder/keyfield only. ScheduleForm.tsx:163-188 and SlotDetail.tsx:226 import Field.module.css and draw raw inputs (disabled, maxLength, type=datetime-local, textarea); 49 more raw controls across 29 files, ~half with no aria-label on the opening line, which bypasses Field's REQUIRED name (registry ui-controls/adoption-enforcement: 'a field primitive with four adopters and nineteen hand-rolled look-alikes'). Fixed: Field grows `disabled` (aria-disabled + readOnly, per the Button convention), `type`, `maxLength`, a `TextArea`; then a ratchet that only falls.

## Flow
- count raw text controls outside field/ (51) vs adopters (22)
- add the props with tests
- add the ratchet at 51; migrate per touched file

## Expected impact
Every text control inherits the required name and keyfield wiring. Could break: busy-state behaviour where callers relied on native disabled leaving the tab order.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - text controls that go through the primitive
Before: 22 of 73 (grep, this tree)
After: predicted ratchet at 51 that only falls; first migration (ScheduleForm, SlotDetail) 5 fewer
Method: probe - counted by grep; the prop additions are in scope but the migrations are in floor/audio/part contexts
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
grep -rnE '<(input|select|textarea)\b' app packages/ui/src (minus checkbox/radio/file/range/hidden/color, minus Field.tsx): 51
grep -rnE '<(Field|Select|Search)\b': 22
packages/ui/src/components/floor/ScheduleForm.tsx:26,163-188
instrument: a vitest ratchet in packages/ui/test that walks app/ and packages/ui/src for raw text controls (comments stripped, walk-read-nothing guard) with budget 51; Field prop cases in controls.test.ts

title: The style contract says the kit cannot draw five things it now draws
body:
## Summary
docs/next/style-contract/README.md lists six prototype features 'the kit cannot draw yet'; five of them are props today, so the contract still omits them from its roles.

## Description
README.md:85-92: Seg option glyph (Seg.tsx:16-21 glyph), Toggle keycap/glyph (Toggle.tsx:19-22), Tally inside Button (Button.tsx:31), glyph after a label (Button.tsx:33) are all drawn; only 'an act in a Panel head' still is not (Panel.tsx:16-27). The roles JSON therefore measures none of the five against the prototype. Fixed: add the five roles to the contract files and rerun the contract runner; drop them from the list.

## Flow
- read README:85-92 against the props
- add roles to contract.ledger.json / contract.library.json
- run the style-contract runner on the dev server

## Expected impact
Five drawn shapes get measured against the prototype. Could break: a role that measures a real drift and goes red (that is the point).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - prototype features measured by the contract
Before: 0 of 5 drawable features measured; 5 of 6 'cannot draw' entries false (code read)
After: predicted 5 of 5 measured
Method: probe - the false entries are counted; measuring them needs the contract runner against a dev server, out of this round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: docs/next/style-contract runner with the five roles added, against GRAVITONE_PRODUCE_SIDE=fixture next dev; before 0 rows for them, after 5 rows each pass or accept
drain_note: needs a dev server and the registry

title: The level sheet's bar and a panel head cannot shrink at phone width
body:
## Summary
LevelSheet's bar holds the crumbs and the close button in one fixed-height row with no wrap or truncation, and Panel's head is white-space:nowrap with no overflow rule.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/sheet/LevelSheet.module.css:10 `.bar{display:flex;height:var(--h-sheet-bar)}`, `.close{margin-left:auto}` and Crumbs with a Board packet id ('Forge · 2026-08-26-sweep-01'); Panel.module.css:3 `.head{white-space:nowrap}` with no overflow/text-overflow. At 375px the trail plus 'Esc Board' plausibly exceeds the sheet's width; nothing clips or wraps it. Fixed: min-width:0 + ellipsis on the crumbs, close kept whole; panel head text-overflow:ellipsis.

## Flow
- open a Board packet at 375 px
- bar: crumbs + close wider than the sheet -> horizontal overflow (predicted)
- fix: min-width:0 and ellipsis on the trail

## Expected impact
The way back stays on screen on a phone. Could break: a crumb that truncates where the full id is wanted (the sheet's aria-label keeps it whole).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the sheet's way back fits at phone width
Before: unmeasured: predicted overflow at 375 px for a Board packet trail
After: predicted 0 px horizontal overflow
Method: simulation - needs cx-capture / the live lane at 375 px; no dev server in this round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: CX_BASE=... node pipeline/cx-capture.mjs board-* out.png --width 375, plus a live assertion that the sheet's scrollWidth <= clientWidth
